description: Term 6 of thm:six-term-mass-formula-complete via partial-fraction polar split on the u-plane lift tr_M(u²): tr_M(u²) = entire(u) + A(u)/u^k + B(u)/Dprime(u), with Term 6 = B(u₀)/Dprime(u₀) the principal-part contribution at non-zero poles only.  This split avoids per-pole residue extraction; sp.div + one sp.series-based power-series inversion deliver the answer in seconds where sp.residue scaled polynomially in atom size and timed out at deuteron.  Evaluation enabled by the Markov-axiom recursive ascent (#508 / PR #516) returning tr_M as a symbolic rational function in q^{1/2}.
